name: setresuid
synopsis: int setresuid(uid_t ruid, uid_t euid, uid_t suid);
description: setresuid() sets the real user ID, effective user ID, and saved set-user-ID of the calling process. An unprivileged process can only change these IDs to their current values, while a privileged process can set them to arbitrary values. If an argument is -1, the corresponding ID is not changed.

parameters.name: ruid
parameters.description: The new real user ID, or -1 to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: The new effective user ID, or -1 to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: suid
parameters.description: The new saved set-user-ID, or -1 to leave unchanged.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real UID, but there was a temporary failure allocating kernel data structures or it would exceed the RLIMIT_NPROC limit.
One or more of the target user IDs is not valid in this user namespace.
The calling process is not privileged and tried to change the IDs to values that are not permitted.
